```{r}
exp2_dt <- read_dt('./exp2_data')

exp2_dt <- exp2_dt[presentation_time != 20]

exp2_dt[prev_duration %in% c(50) &
         prev_duration2 %in% c(50),
         prev_duration_cat := 50]

exp2_dt[prev_duration %in% c(200) &
         prev_duration2 %in% c(200),
         prev_duration_cat := 200]

exp2_dt[prev_duration %in% c(400) &
         prev_duration2 %in% c(400),
       prev_duration_cat := 400]

# remove first three trials in each block for perfect n-1 and n-2 counterbalancing
exp2_dt <- exp2_dt[db_counter > 3]

# from ms to seconds
exp2_dt[, prev_duration := prev_duration / 1000]
exp2_dt[, prev_duration2 := prev_duration2 / 1000]
exp2_dt[, prev_duration_cat := prev_duration_cat / 1000]


```

#### Effect of encoding speed on capacity
```{r}
# Block experiment
rho_block <- cor.test(exp1_summary_boot_dt$pars_dt[i==1, rate_ratio],
                exp1_summary_boot_dt$pars_dt[i==1, c_ratio],
                method='spearman') 
label <- paste0('list(rho == ', 
                as.character(round(rho_block$estimate, 2)),
                ' , p < 0.001)')
speed_to_capacity_block <- ggplot(exp1_summary_boot_dt$pars_dt[i==1], 
                            aes(x=rate_ratio, y=c_ratio)) +
  geom_point(color='grey50', alpha=0.5, shape=16, size=2) + 
  geom_smooth(method='lm', color='black') +
  ylab('normalized capacity') +
  xlab('normalized rate') +
  ggtitle('blocked information rate') +
  expand_limits(x=c(0, 3), y=c(0, 3)) +
  annotate('text', 
           label=label, parse=T,
           x=1.5, y=2.5, size=4) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=12))

# Sequential experiment
rho_n1 <- cor.test(exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit[, rate_ratio],
                exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit[, c_ratio],
                method='spearman') 
label <- paste0('list(rho == ', 
                as.character(round(rho_n1$estimate, 2)),
                ' , p < 0.001)')
speed_to_capacity_n1 <- ggplot(exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit, 
                            aes(x=rate_ratio, y=c_ratio)) +
  geom_point(color='grey50', alpha=0.5, shape=16, size=2) + 
  geom_smooth(method='lm', color='black') +
  xlab('normalized rate') +
  ylab('') +
  ggtitle('n-1 information rate') +
  expand_limits(x=c(0, 3), y=c(0, 3)) +
  annotate('text', 
           label=label, parse=T,
           x=1.5, y=2.5, size=4) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=12))

rho_n12 <- cor.test(exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit[, rate_ratio],
                exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit[, c_ratio],
                method='spearman') 
label <- paste0('list(rho == ', 
                as.character(round(rho_n12$estimate, 2)),
                ' , p < 0.001)')
speed_to_capacity_n12 <- ggplot(exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit, 
                            aes(x=rate_ratio, y=c_ratio)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, shape=16, size=2) + 
  geom_smooth(method='lm', color='black') +
  ylab('') +
  xlab('normalized rate') +
  ggtitle('n-1 and n-2 information rate') +
  expand_limits(x=c(0, 3), y=c(0, 3)) +
  annotate('text', 
           label=label, parse=T,
           x=1.5, y=2.5, size=4) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=12))

speed_to_capacity <- speed_to_capacity_block + speed_to_capacity_n1 + speed_to_capacity_n12

speed_to_capacity
#ggsave('speed_to_capacity.png', dpi=400, width=9, height=3)
```


#### Adaptation from 200 to 400 ms (in n-1 and n-2)
```{r}
#exp2_n12_boot <- bootstrap_adwm(exp2_dt, c('prev_duration_cat'),
#                                n_iter=100)

#save(exp2_n12_boot, file='exp2_n12_summary_boot_dt.RData')
load("./exp2_n12_summary_boot_dt.RData")
```

```{r}
pars_dt <- exp2_n12_boot$pars_dt

tmp <- pars_dt
setkey(tmp, 'subject_nr', 'i', 'prev_duration_cat')

tmp <- dcast(tmp, subject_nr + i ~ prev_duration_cat, 
             value.var = 'rate_ratio')
colnames(tmp) <- c('subject_nr', 'i', 'short', 'med', 'long')

# compute difference
tmp[, rate_diff := med - long]
```

```{r}
library(ggridges)
tmp[, mean_rdiff := mean(rate_diff, na.rm=T), by='subject_nr']
tmp[, slow := mean_rdiff > median(mean_rdiff)]
setkey(tmp, mean_rdiff)
tmp$subject_nr <- factor(tmp$subject_nr,
                         levels = tmp[, unique(subject_nr)])

rate_diff_plot <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x=rate_diff, y=subject_nr,
                                  fill=slow)) +
  geom_density_ridges() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype='dashed', color='grey') +
  ggtitle('Rate difference (200ms vs. 400ms)') +
  xlab('Rate difference n-1 and n-2') +
  ylab('Participant') + 
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = 'None')

color_indices <- c(1, 4)
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'RdBu')[color_indices]
pars_dt[subject_nr %in% tmp[slow==T, subject_nr], 
        slow := T]
pars_dt[subject_nr %in% tmp[slow==F, subject_nr], 
        slow := F]
rdiff_encoding_plot <- ggplot(data = pars_dt[!(is.na(slow)) &
                                               i==1], 
                      aes(x=1/prev_duration_cat, 
                          y=rate_ratio, color=slow,
                          fill=slow, group=slow)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept=1, color='lightgrey',
               size=1.5, linetype='dashed') +
    xlab(expression(paste('n-1 and n-2 information rate (', 
                              s^-1, ')'))) +
    #scale_fill_manual(values = plot_colours) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks= c(0.5, 1., 1.5)) +
    #stat_summary(geom='line', color='black', size=1) +
    #geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE, color='black') +
    stat_summary(geom='line') +
    stat_summary(geom='pointrange', size=0.75,
                 shape=21, color='black') +
    ylab(expression(paste('norm. ', rad^-1, '/ms'))) +
    ggtitle('Encoding speed') +
    expand_limits(y=c(0.5, 1.8), x=c(0)) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = 'None',
          plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))

rate_diff_plot <- rate_diff_plot + rdiff_encoding_plot
rate_diff_plot
ggsave('rate_diff_plot.png', dpi=400, width=8, height=5)
```

### Estimating Circular Standard deviation
```{r}
# Demonstration: underestimation of circular sd for low sample sizes
dt <- data.table(sd = numeric(),
                 est_sd = numeric(),
                 n = numeric())
ns <- c(5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160)

for(sd in (seq(0.1, 3, by=0.1))){
  for(n in ns){
    for(i in 1:100){
      data <- rwrappednormal(n, sd=sd)
      est_sd <- sd.circular(data)
      
      dt <- rbindlist(list(dt, 
                           data.table(sd = sd,
                                      est_sd = est_sd,
                                      n = n)))
    }
  }
}

color_indices <- c(3:(length(ns)+3))
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'Greys')[color_indices]

circular_sd_N_plot <- ggplot(dt, aes(x=sd, y=est_sd, 
                                     color=as.factor(n), group=as.factor(n))) + 
  stat_summary(geom='line') +  
  scale_color_manual(values=plot_colours, name='N', breaks=rev(ns)) +
  geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1, linetype='dashed') +
  expand_limits(x=c(0, 3), y=c(0, 3)) +
  xlab('True circular sd') +
  ylab('Estimated circular sd') +
  theme_cowplot()

circular_sd_N_plot

#ggsave('cirular_sd_N.png', dpi=400)
```

```{r}
# Generate generate data for several sample sizes with sd = 2
n_originals <- 100
n_bootstraps <- 100
n <- 25
bootstrap_dt <- data.table(sd_difference = numeric(),
                           sd = numeric(),
                           sd_est = numeric(),
                           replacement = logical(), 
                           n=numeric())

for(sd in (seq(0.1, 3, by=0.1))){
  for(i in 1:n_originals){
    data <- rwrappednormal(n, sd=sd)
    replacement_sd <- c()
    no_replacement_sd <- c()
    
    for(j in 1:n_bootstraps){
      replacement_sd[j] <- sd.circular(sample(data, n-1, replace=T))
      no_replacement_sd[j] <- sd.circular(sample(data, n-1, replace=F))
    }
    
    bootstrap_dt <- rbindlist(list(bootstrap_dt, 
                         data.table(sd_difference = replacement_sd - 
                                      sd,
                                    sd = sd,
                                    sd_est = replacement_sd,
                                    replacement = T,
                                    n = n),
                         data.table(sd_difference = no_replacement_sd - 
                                      sd,
                                    sd = sd,
                                    sd_est = no_replacement_sd,
                                    replacement = F, 
                                    n=n)))
  }
}

replacement_bias <- ggplot(bootstrap_dt, aes(x=sd, y=sd_est, 
                         group=replacement, color=replacement)) +
  stat_summary(geom='line', size=1) +
  scale_color_discrete(name='', labels=c('without replacement',
                                         'with replacement')) +
  geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1, linetype='dashed') +
  expand_limits(x=c(0, 3), y=c(0, 3)) +
  ggtitle('Bias') +
  xlab('True circular sd') +
  ylab('Estimated circular sd') +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5),
        legend.position = c(0.4, 0.3))

  
replacement_variance <- ggplot(bootstrap_dt[, .(var=var(sd_est)), 
                                            by=c('sd', 'replacement')],
       aes(x=sd, y=var, group=replacement, color=replacement)) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  ggtitle('Variance') +
  ylab('variance of estimate') +
  xlab('True circular sd') +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5),
        legend.position = 'None')
  
replacement_plot <- replacement_bias + replacement_variance
replacement_plot

#ggsave('replacement_plot.png', dpi=400, width=8, height=5)
```
